title: VK-only Single Command with short conservative command ASDU
purpose: Cover a command-oriented I-frame using a compact command body that remains structurally plausible and can be mutated toward count or object-address edge cases linked to short-ASDU parsing issues.
expected_behavior: A parser should treat this as a small command-like I-frame and either process or reject it cleanly, with no out-of-bounds access when later mutations vary count, IOA, or qualifier bytes.
constraints_preserved: target operation preserved as Single Command
issue_safety_notes: This keeps a full visible IOA and minimal body to avoid the exact missing-IOA crash structure while remaining close enough for safe mutation toward issue-related boundaries.
